ModMetaData.name: RimRising
ModMetaData.author: cinergy92
ModMetaData.description:
A total conversion built around an engineered caste hierarchy: fourteen Colors, each a xenotype with its own capabilities and its own costs, bound together by a social order that gives the hierarchy real mechanical weight.
WHAT IT ADDS - Fourteen Colors as inheritable xenotypes, plus Bronzies and six sub-strains, ranked by a ladder the game actually enforces. - Carving: a Violet Carver can regrow a lost limb, cut away scarring, rebuild someone's fertility so they can cross Colors, or rebuild a person into another Color entirely. Only a Violet may do any of it. - Razors, pulse and recoil armour with an automated trauma suite, gravBoots that launch across the world map, and an aegis. - Six factions, two ideoligion memes, two title ladders, and a storyteller. - Drugs from the source: zoladone, mjolnir-6, nazopran, god's bread and fever cloud.
REQUIREMENTS Royalty, Ideology and Biotech are all required - Biotech for the Colors, Ideology for the hierarchy memes and precepts, Royalty for the Society's title ladders. Several mods are required too; RimWorld will list them all if any are missing, and the mod will not load without them.
OPTIONAL EXTRAS, each loaded only if you already run it: Combat Extended, the Exosuit Framework (starShell), Vehicle Framework (Drachenjaeger) and Alpha Animals (Carvelings). Melee Animation also animates both razors, including its executions. None is required and nothing else changes if you have none of them.
This mod is a work in progress. Worn apparel art is still being refined.
CREDITS AND DISCLOSURE An unofficial fan work inspired by Pierce Brown's Red Rising novels. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or his publishers, and no text or artwork from the books is reproduced; every description and every image is original.
Built with Claude Code (Anthropic). Item, weapon and preview art was generated locally with Z-Image-Turbo and a ControlNet, guided by hand-built procedural silhouettes; icons, worn apparel and terrain are drawn procedurally. Sound effects were generated with fal (fal.ai) using ElevenLabs Sound Effects v2.
Thanks to the authors of every mod listed above as a requirement, and to Epicguru for Melee Animation, whose override folders made razor support possible without touching their mod.
